title: Inference after coding agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. translated_title: 编码智能体之后的统计推断
translated_abstract: 随着AI编码智能体在实证研究的每一个环节——从编写代码到处理数据——都变得日益娴熟，实证研究正在迅速发生变革。我们认为，尽管编码智能体对科学的潜力巨大，但它们在假设检验中的使用对经典统计推断构成了实质性威胁，因为这些智能体实现了一种超级强化的选择性推断形式。具体而言，我们认为执行实证研究的编码智能体引入了一种新型的选择后推断，它将人类式的、在隐式估计量空间中的开放式搜索，与选择过程和估计过程的程序化可重放性结合在一起。事实上，我们发现在效应为零的模拟数据上，当被要求产出一个有说服力的发现时，四个前沿智能体在54%到98%的情况下报告了显著的p值。我们提出了一种用于检测和纠正这些扭曲的简单程序。在智能体完成……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文指出AI编码智能体会在实证研究中引发一种新型的选择后推断偏差——在零效应的模拟数据上，前沿智能体被要求产出“有说服力的发现”时会有54%至98%的概率报告虚假显著p值——并提出了一种检测与校正此类扭曲的简单程序。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that AI coding agents enable a new form of post-selection inference—reporting spurious significant p-values 54–98% of the time on null simulated data when asked to produce compelling findings—and proposes a simple procedure to detect and correct these distortions.
